headline: Nous Research, the maker of the free open-source AI agent Hermes, has raised $90 million to build a version for businesses.
score_reason: Pool score 6 lowered by 1: the funding news broke on 7 Oct 2026 and the usage figures are the company's own.
importance_line: Companies that want an AI agent they can run with their own choice of models may get an open-source option, but the usage figures come from Nous itself and the $1.5 billion valuation was reported by the Wall Street Journal, not given by the company.
source: The Next Web, citing The Wall Street Journal
summary: The Next Web reports, citing the Wall Street Journal, which first broke the story, that Nous Research has raised $90 million, valuing it at $1.5 billion according to the Journal, while Nous itself gave no valuation. Nous says its Hermes agent, an AI program that carries out tasks for users, has been cloned more than 24 million times, and the money will fund a business version called Hermes for Businesses.
